task.title: P6-033: Add a by-codes lookup so set chips can show names outside the current window
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-033. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/catalog-search.md.

**A set chip cannot show its set name unless that set happens to be in the current 25-row window** — `rail.rs:975-999` labels chips with `code.to_ascii_uppercase()` unconditionally, and no by-codes lookup exists anywhere in `app/src` or `shared/src`. Resolving selected codes to names needs a by-codes read.
